selectionPolicy: Explicit table allowlist only. Never select a complete PostgreSQL schema and never expand automatically through foreign keys. Supporting tables do not authorize additional business modules or API pages.
frontend: React shell only; no business-module pages
supportingTableRestrictions: No standalone identity/organization administration implementation is authorized by these supporting references.
Material planning input snapshots do not authorize forecast-management, daily-production, inventory-ledger, purchase-order or production-order modules.
Trading business cards/parties are setup lookups only; no full licensing/card lifecycle implementation.
project_stages is retained only to map the already implemented project start/referral date, not to implement future Trading stages.
Source-only fields such as project priority, eight-digit bank code, FX, customs and future workflow fields must not be exposed by current DTOs merely because their table is selected.
explicitlyOutOfScope: inventory transactions, transfers and warehouse administration
production orders, reporting, work centers and manufacturing routes
what-if scenarios and advanced MRP route/certificate/outbox extensions
full identity, roles, permissions, sessions and security-administration module
Trading FX, bank allocations, insurance, shipments, customs, commitments and costs
Trading project document management and future stage workflows
